profile.headline: Software Engineer with experience in C#/.NET
profile.summary: Graduate of Ohio University with a Bachelor of Science degree in Aviation Management and minors in Business Administration and Communication. Coursework in C# and OOP.  6+ years in the United States Coast Guard attached to a tactical expeditionary unit. Previous sensor operator experience on manned and unmanned platforms. Active security clearance. Private Pilot, and Part 107 Remote Pilot certificates. Currently working as a software engineer for Boeing.

positions.title: Airborne Sensor Operator
positions.locationName: St. Louis County, Missouri, United States
positions.description: Collected airborne imagery using a Leica ADS sensor for clients ranging from local municipalities, federal entities, and private companies. Downloaded and transferred data files to company FTP after every mission and ship hard drives for processing. Assisted pilot in weather monitoring and project area progress to ensure efficient and quality data acquisition. Processed acquired orthoimagery to rectify coordinates, refine the color balance and remove irregularities.

positions.title: Sensor Operator
positions.description: Utilized a Raytheon Multi-Spectral Targeting System, composed of EO/IR sensors, laser designator, and laser illuminator, to perform ISR functions in support of U.S. Army programs. Functioned as second in command aircrew member to support the PIC with the safe operation of the aircraft –demonstrating effective crew resource management, reading checklists, and assisting in emergencies. Supported mission planning for optimal success through pre-briefing, aircraft and payload inspections, debriefing, and documentation. Displayed an exceptional ability to learn new methods and an initiative to receive instruction by holding multiple qualifications on MQ-1 UAS platforms.

positions.title: Customs Coordinator
positions.description: Established, monitored, updated and quality checked all US Customs & Canadian CANPASS clearances for NJA international flight operations. Monitored daily international flight activities, aircraft departures and estimated arrival times to ensure timely/accurate updates are provided to Customs to facilitate the efficient processing of NetJets flights. Properly documented all situations or deviations that affect the quality of basic flight activity to provide accurate information to support decision-making.

positions.title: Boatswain's Mate
positions.description: Oversaw the actions of lower-ranking enlisted personnel and supervise their progress while encouraging them to achieve advancement. Executed rigorous physical tasks such as towing with the 32 foot Transportable Port Security Boats (TPSB) and securing the anchoring of vessels while underway. Maintained the highest level of port security at assigned location and provide escorts for authorized vessels to enter the security zone.

positions.title: Boatswain's Mate
positions.description: Performed anti-terrorism and force protection for Joint Task Force Guantanamo as a tactical boat crewman. Provided around-the-clock waterborne security, maritime interdiction, and point defense to Department of Defense assets. Upheld the highest level of safety and confidentiality in accordance with unit established standard operating procedures to complete mission planning and execution. Operated as the administrative liaison using various computer applications to assist with pay, travel claims, and discrepancies for a 50-person division.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description: Consistently worked in a fast paced environment where required to multitask in efforts to serve customer’s orders in a timely manner. Maintained proper sanitary regulations of my work space and surrounding areas. Created an exceptional customer service atmosphere and relationship. Responsible for the handling and deposit of cash sales at the end of each shift.

positions.title: Collegiate Ambassador
positions.description: Promoted various Monster Energy drinks in a positive and creative manner. Composed semi-monthly reports detailing the Monster sampling events that I had planned and how consumers reacted to the product. Networked with organizations on the University's campus to promote Monster Energy Drinks at their events.

positions.title: Inflight Operations Intern
positions.description: Cross referenced various manuals to ensure compliance with IATA Operational Safety Audit and presented discrepancies to the Safety Auditor and Cabin Manager. Provided support in the organization and planning of the company based holiday, Flight Attendant Appreciation Month. Partook in hands on Flight Attendant training, aircraft familiarization, and EFB distribution. Assisted in the manual harmonization process between Republic Airways and Shuttle America. Experience using Sabre for monitoring crew schedules and flight delays.

positions.title: Event Publicist
positions.description: Created weekly promotions highlighting events such as performances, recitals, and exhibitions occurring within the College of Fine Arts using Constant Contact software. Collected local and national editorial and newsworthy pieces regarding the College of Fine Arts and use them as promotions within the college’s own social media sites

company.name: Ohio University College of Fine Arts

positions.title: Fundraising Call Representative
positions.description: Demonstrated the ability solicit and secure monetary donations via pre-assigned call list. Executed the fundamentals of making a quality call. Prepared and maintained accurate records to monitor and evaluate results
